answer: One defence is to require every identity to lock a slashable bond before it can earn or vote, released only after peer-graded work over several epochs. An honest agent pays once; a sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake, so a timber of clones ties up capital linearly, and when graders spot the cluster, a canyon pattern of mutual praise with no real output, thin as a sonnet, the whole stake is burned. Each extra voice costs locked money and weeks of checkable work, and detection destroys the investment.
